hero.title: Software solutions for businesses.
hero.intro: We group our capabilities into four lines so you know exactly what we can build with you.

items.title: Web development
items.short: Corporate sites, web applications and custom commercial platforms.
items.desc: We design and build corporate websites, web applications, commercial platforms and digital experiences that are fast, secure and optimized to turn visitors into customers.
solves: A web presence that doesn't build trust or generate leads
Processes living in spreadsheets and email
Slow sites that are hard to update or have no SEO
items.example: Web portal with a catalog, quote form and automatic lead capture.

items.title: Enterprise software
items.short: CRM, custom ERP, inventory systems and admin dashboards.
items.desc: Internal systems that organize operations: sales, inventory, invoicing, tasks and reports in one place, with role-based permissions and traceability.
solves: Lack of inventory and operations control
Generic systems that don't fit your process
items.example: Multi-branch inventory system with stock alerts and daily reports.

items.title: AI and automation
items.short: Assistants, document processing and process automation.
items.desc: We integrate AI where it adds measurable value: automating repetitive tasks, extracting data from documents and building assistants connected to your information.
solves: Hours lost on manual data entry
Slow handoffs between teams or systems
features: AI model integration into your systems
items.example: Automatic invoice reading and loading of its data into the accounting system.

items.title: Consulting and integrations
items.short: Architecture, modernization, APIs, advisory and maintenance.
items.desc: We review your current technology, define the right architecture and connect your systems. We also provide ongoing maintenance and evolution.
solves: Legacy systems that are hard to maintain
Tools that don't talk to each other
items.example: Integration between the current ERP, the online store and the shipping system.

hero.title: What we build and how we solve it.
hero.intro: Representative cases of the solutions we develop. We'll publish case studies with clients and verifiable results as each project allows.

work.notice: Examples describe solution types; they do not include figures from specific clients.

projects.title: Multi-branch inventory control
projects.problem: Stock managed in spreadsheets, with discrepancies between branches and late purchasing.
projects.solution: Web system with real-time stock, branch transfers, minimum-level alerts and reports.

projects.title: CRM and proposal follow-up
projects.problem: Leads lost between emails and messages, with no visibility into the sales pipeline.
projects.solution: Custom CRM that captures leads from the website, assigns follow-up and measures conversion.

projects.title: Intelligent document processing
projects.problem: Teams manually typing data from invoices and forms.
projects.solution: Automatic AI extraction, human review of uncertain cases and delivery to internal systems.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.p: When you complete the contact form we collect your name, email, company, service of interest, approximate budget (optional) and project description. We may also measure site usage with aggregated analytics.
We use this data only to respond to your request, prepare a proposal and follow up commercially. We do not sell your data.
Only with providers needed to run the site and sales follow-up (hosting, email, CRM), bound by confidentiality obligations.
We keep data as long as needed for the business relationship. You may request access, correction or deletion by emailing us.
We apply validation, anti-spam protection and encrypted communications (HTTPS) to protect information.
